## Dekking chemie



```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(HHSKwkl)
library(readxl)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)

theme_set(hhskthema())

meetpunten <- data_online("meetpunten.rds")

jaar <- 2027

pad <- "../../data/tabellen_monitoringsplan_OMS-18-8-2026.xlsx"

meetnetten        <- read_excel(pad, "meetnetten")             %>% 
  filter(!is.na(meetnet_code)) %>% 
  select(1:13)

peilgebieden <- get_open_gisdata("peilgebieden") %>% select(CODE, NAAM)

f_meetnetcode <- meetnetten %>% select(meetnet_nr, meetnet_code) %>% maak_opzoeker()

peilgebieden_met_meetpunt <- 
  meetnetten %>% 
  filter(meetnet_nr < 100) %>% 
  filter(is.na(datum_eind) | datum_eind > make_date(jaar)) %>%  
  select(mp = meetpunt_code, meetnet_nr, meetnet_code) %>%
  # summarise(meetnet_nr = min(meetnet_nr), .by = mp) %>% 
  distinct() %>%
  left_join(meetpunten) %>% 
  st_as_sf(coords = c(x = "x", y = "y"), crs = 28992, remove = FALSE) %>% 
  st_join(peilgebieden) %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  # select(CODE, NAAM, meetnet_nr) %>% 
  summarise(meetnet_nr = min(meetnet_nr), .by = c(CODE, NAAM)) %>% 
  filter_out(is.na(CODE)) %>% 
  mutate(meetnet_code = f_meetnetcode(meetnet_nr))
  
pal <- colorFactor("Accent", domain = unique(peilgebieden_met_meetpunt$meetnet_code))

peilgebieden %>% 
  inner_join(peilgebieden_met_meetpunt) %>% 
  st_transform(crs = 4326) %>% 
  basiskaart("cartolight") %>% 
  addPolygons(stroke = FALSE, fillOpacity = 0.8, fillColor = ~pal(meetnet_code), label = ~CODE) %>% 
  addLegend(pal = pal, values = ~meetnet_code, opacity = 1) %>% 
  addPolylines(data = ws_grens_wgs, color = grijs_m, opacity = 1, weight = 3)  
  # htmlwidgets::saveWidget("C:/data/temp/dekking_chemie_peilgebieden.html")


    

```

## Dekking quickscan

```{r}

peilgebieden_met_meetpuntqs <- 
    
# meetpunten_quickscan <- 
  meetnetten %>% 
  filter(meetnet_nr == 102) %>% 
  filter(is.na(datum_eind) | datum_eind > make_date(jaar)) %>%  
  select(mp = meetpunt_code, meetnet_nr, meetnet_code) %>%
  # summarise(meetnet_nr = min(meetnet_nr), .by = mp) %>% 
  distinct() %>%
  left_join(meetpunten) %>% 
  st_as_sf(coords = c(x = "x", y = "y"), crs = 28992, remove = FALSE) %>% 
  st_join(peilgebieden) %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  select(CODE, NAAM) %>%
  filter_out(is.na(CODE)) %>% 
  distinct()

peilgebieden %>% 
  inner_join(peilgebieden_met_meetpuntqs) %>% 
  st_transform(crs = 4326) %>% 
  basiskaart("cartolight") %>% 
  addPolygons(stroke = FALSE, fillOpacity = 0.8, label = ~CODE) %>% 
  addPolylines(data = ws_grens_wgs, color = grijs_m, opacity = 1, weight = 3)
```
